dbo.AG ag LEFT JOIN (SELECT FCCode, BPCode,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT BPName) = 1 THEN MAX(BPName) END AS BPName
  FROM dbo.V_BP GROUP BY FCCode, BPCode) bp ON bp.BPCode = ag.BPCode AND bp.FCCode = ag.FCCode
    OUTER APPLY (SELECT
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT conceptItem.ItemName) = 1 THEN MAX(conceptItem.ItemName) END AS ItemName
  FROM dbo.V_IT conceptItem WHERE conceptItem.ItemCode = ag.Deductible) deductibleItem
    OUTER APPLY (SELECT
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT conceptItem.ItemName) = 1 THEN MAX(conceptItem.ItemName) END AS ItemName
  FROM dbo.V_IT conceptItem WHERE conceptItem.ItemCode = ag.CopayAmount) copayAmountItem
    OUTER APPLY (SELECT
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT conceptItem.ItemName) = 1 THEN MAX(conceptItem.ItemName) END AS ItemName
  FROM dbo.V_IT conceptItem WHERE conceptItem.ItemCode = ag.CopayPercentage) copayPercentageItem
    OUTER APPLY (SELECT
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT conceptItem.ItemName) = 1 THEN MAX(conceptItem.ItemName) END AS ItemName
  FROM dbo.V_IT conceptItem WHERE conceptItem.ItemCode = ag.Coinsurance) coinsuranceItem
    OUTER APPLY (SELECT
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT conceptItem.ItemName) = 1 THEN MAX(conceptItem.ItemName) END AS ItemName
  FROM dbo.V_IT conceptItem WHERE conceptItem.ItemCode = ag.CoinsurancePercentage) coinsurancePercentageItem

staticSapQueries.sq_v6_grpo: SELECT TOP 5000 T0.DocNum, T0.DocDate, T0.DocDueDate, T0.CardCode, T0.CardName, T1.ItemCode, T1.Dscription, T1.Quantity, T1.Price, T1.LineTotal, T0.DocTotal, T1.WhsCode, T0.Comments FROM OPDN T0 INNER JOIN PDN1 T1 ON T0.DocEntry = T1.DocEntry WHERE T0.DocDate >= :startDate AND T0.DocDate <= :endDate ORDER BY T0.DocDate DESC
staticSapQueries.sq_v6_gret: SELECT TOP 5000 T0.DocNum, T0.DocDate, T0.CardCode, T0.CardName, T1.ItemCode, T1.Dscription, T1.Quantity, T1.Price, T1.LineTotal, T0.DocTotal, T1.WhsCode, T0.Comments FROM ORPD T0 INNER JOIN RPD1 T1 ON T0.DocEntry = T1.DocEntry WHERE T0.DocDate >= :startDate AND T0.DocDate <= :endDate ORDER BY T0.DocDate DESC
